Global Winners
Congratulations to the 2023 NASA International Space Apps Challenge Global Winners!
This year's winners represent the top ten projects from the 5,500+ teams that submitted projects in the NASA Space Apps Challenge. NASA Space Apps Executive Judges selected the winners from the pool of
Global Finalists
.
This year's Global Winners represent teams from 11 different countries and territories. Their projects showcase what's possible when we "Explore Open Science Together" using open-source data from NASA and our partner space agencies.
We are so proud of these teams and grateful to the entire NASA Space Apps community for making the hackathon such a success. For more information on the judging process, see the
Judging & Awards Guide
.
